snippet.title: Wyldernook Gameplay Trailer (old trailer)
snippet.description:
Choose a champion. Build your strategy. Predict your opponents. Reveal together. Watch the chaos unfold. 

Wyldernook is a storybook-inspired strategy card game where every champion unlocks a new way to build, battle, and outplay your opponents.

Craft your deck around powerful champion abilities, discover unique card synergies, and develop strategies that fit your playstyle.

Battles aren't won by reacting, they're won by predicting.

Plan actions in secret, commit your strategy, and watch every champion execute simultaneously as carefully laid plans collide in explosive battles. Every turn is a test of foresight, timing, and tactical decision-making.

Features:
• Champion-based deckbuilding with distinct playstyles
• Simultaneous turn resolution and strategic prediction
• Deep card synergies and creative deck construction
• Storybook-inspired worldbuilding and exploration
• Competitive multiplayer and endless strategic possibilities

Wishlist Wyldernook on Steam( https://store.steampowered.com/app/1622400/Wyldernook/ ) and follow development for future updates.
